title: Sotong
description: A real-time internal monitoring dashboard using React and Next.js for HAUD System Indonesia to track A2P SMS traffic (OTPs, notifications, etc.), providing live logging and delivery status visibility.

title: SafeCircle Mobile App
description: SafeCircle is a comprehensive mobile apps using Flutter for neighborhood security with Emergency Alerts, Crime Mapping, and Community Safety Tools. It is designed to help users stay safe and connected with their neighbors.

title: SafeCircle Backend
description: SafeCircle is a comprehensive backend service using Express.js, MariaDB, and JWT to provide API for SafeCircle mobile app.
